newsitem.title: USA: Penwest intervenes in Pfizer/FDA suit.
newsitem.headline: Penwest intervenes in Pfizer/FDA suit.

text.p: Penwest Ltd said Wednesday it had filed a motion to intervene as a defendant in Pfizer Inc's lawsuit against the Food and Drug Administration.
In a suit filed July 8 in federal court in Washington, Pfizer challenged the FDA's acceptance of Mylan Laboratories Inc's Abbreviated New Drug Application for controlled-release nifedipine tablets.
Penwest said Mylan licensed Penwest's TIMER oral controlled-release technology for its tablets.
On July 11 Mylan also filed a motion to intervene in the Pfizer suit as a defendant.
Penwest makes specialty carbohydrate and synthetic polymer chemicals for papermaking and produces specialty food ingredients, agricultural nutrition supplements and pharmaceutical excipient products.
